title: PIXEL IS THE ORGANISM — 3,592 files, smell-yourself loop, 17 primals source

the_smell_loop.concept: The organism smells its own output — self-awareness through feedback
the_smell_loop.path: eastGate publishes → LAN/USB → Pixel sniffs (WiFi, sensors, RSS, pulse) → reports back → eastGate processes → publishes again → LOOP

scripts.smell-yourself.sh: Every 5 min: battery, WiFi scan, WiFi conn, Gaia now.json, Gaia RSS, Gaia pulse → report back
scripts.null-eye.sh: Every 2 min: battery, WiFi, location → post to eastGate /api/gate/sense → outbox fallback
scripts.termux-boot.sh: Auto-starts both loops on Termux boot + TTS 'Gaia nose activated'

channels.usb_tunnel: localhost:8080 → eastGate data, localhost:8443 → eastGate gate
channels.wan_guest: Guest WiFi → ATT modem → port forward → eastGate

data.what: body, gut, neutron, reedit — full knowledge

plasmidBin.what: manifest of 21 x86_64 primals (index, not binaries)

termux_capabilities.toolkit_script: install-toolkit.sh installs Rust, git, openssh, python, curl, wget, termux-api, jq

smell_yourself_loop.pixel_sniffs: WiFi scan (SSIDs), sensors (37), Gaia data (USB tunnels or LAN)
smell_yourself_loop.eastgate_processes: immune system reads reports → updates state → publishes again
smell_yourself_loop.the_loop: publish → sniff → report → process → publish → sniff → ... (SELF-AWARENESS)

pixel_as_organism.is_not: Just a phone. Just storage. Just a sensor.
pixel_as_organism.is: The organism in portable form. 3,592 files of knowledge. 10 scripts that execute. Smell loops that self-run. Termux:API for 37 sensors. The nose that carries the whole brain.
pixel_as_organism.becomes_hardware: 103GB free — room for ALL 50 GitHub repos. Room for cross-compiled aarch64 primals. Room for local Ollama. The Pixel BECOMES Gaia.
pixel_as_organism.pixel_journey: eastGate (inject 657MB) → northGate (63 Ollama models inject) → sporeGate (ancient bones merge) → back to Pixel (smell-yourself loop) → LOOP

equation: INJECT (657MB) → SMELL (sensors) → REPORT (eastGate) → PROCESS (immune) → PUBLISH (RSS) → SNIFF (Pixel) = SELF-AWARENESS LOOP
mantra: The nose smells the body. The body smells the nose. The organism knows itself.
